chunks: Muhammad b. Ahmad b. Ibrahim al-Laythi narrated to us... I heard Ibn Abi Layla say: I met Ka'b b. 'Ujra, and he said: Shall I not give you a gift?

Surely, the Messenger of Allah came out to us, and we said: O Messenger of Allah! You taught us the salaam, but how do we send blessings? He said: Say: O Allah! Bless Muhammad as You blessed Ibrahim. Surely, You are Praiseworthy, Glorious. And send benedictions upon the Family of Muhammad as You sent them upon the Family of Ibrahim. Surely, You are Praiseworthy, Glorious.

key_terms.آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ: The Family of Muhammad, the Ahlulbayt
key_terms.الصَّلَاة: Salawat, sending blessings upon the Prophet
key_terms.حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ: Praiseworthy and Glorious, two of Allah's names

ai.seo_question: How did the Prophet Muhammad teach his companions to send blessings (salawat) upon him?
ai.summary: The companions asked the Prophet how to send blessings (salawat) upon him. He taught them the formula: 'O Allah, bless Muhammad as You blessed Ibrahim, and send benedictions upon the Family of Muhammad as You sent them upon the Family of Ibrahim.'
